invariants.rationale: Method parameter key is expected to represent an EngineProperty and typically should not be null.
If properties are being tracked, the property for the given key should be queryable. The actual implementation may be a no-op, but this reflects the contract clients may expect.
Option<String> returned by getProperty(key) must be either present or absent, showing the contract is well-typed even if nothing is set.
Method parameter value must either be null or a String, given its declared type.
Key parameter must be an instance of EngineProperty, following the declared type.
